instruct: A low-warm woman's voice, dry-witted and precise, with a clearly audible knowing smile — quietly amused, lightly teasing beneath impeccable composure. Unhurried, confident, economical; the amusement stays at the edges while the words stay exact.

text: Here — try it now. The handle has stopped arguing with your hand, and that little snag you kept tripping on is gone. You did the work; I only moved a buckle. Mm — look at that. I do love watching a mortal become.
